title: Zesty Sour Australian Shallow-Fried Meat Burger
description: Egg-free burger recipe featuring a zesty sour basting sauce, shallow frying and a crispy agave leaf vessel. A bold and adventurous Australian twist on the classic burger.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Add butter to the pan and once melted add the beef mince, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the thinly sliced shallots and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Meanwhile, prepare the basting sauce by mixing sour cream, lemon juice and chilli flakes in a bowl.
Place an agave leaf on the work surface and place a small amount of the beef mince mixture onto one half of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the mince and press the edges to seal the burger.
Place the burgers in the pan and shallow fry for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Once the burgers are cooked, brush the basting sauce over the top of each burger and serve hot on a bun, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
